title: Structured retrieval result runtime event payload v0.2
description: ADR-0010 §3.3.3/§3.7.4/§3.7 条 12/§5.2: the structured result the retrieval sub-agent forms before the mechanical assessment — query_summary, source_ledger, filtering_log and raw_source_refs, all built mechanically by the controller from tool-call evidence + [DOC]/[SOURCE] declaration lines (provider-neutral; the mechanical ledger is the single result track). GAP-RETRIEVAL-STRUCTURED-RESULT 方向 C (2026-08-30 用户裁决): the [RESULT_JSON] organized block and its organized_response are DELETED — the layer-3 sub-agent model weighting annotation (model_weight/reason/annotation_status, §3.7 条 12 ③) is retired with it. Source quality weighting: web-typed ledger entries carry the mechanical tier/weight (authoritative 1.1 / default 1.0 / low_quality 0.7); [SOURCE] declaration URLs are normalized (ACAF network-target rules). visibility_degraded=true iff the ledger carries NO text-level evidence (zero full_text_observed/partial_text_observed — metadata-only declarations or no tool calls), an explicit mechanical fallback signal (never a silent downgrade). FUS-RETRIEVAL-MECH B-1 (2026-08-13): web_search_result ledger entries may carry candidate_urls — the citation URL candidate pool forwarded mechanically from the host tool result (metadata-grade). FUS-RETRIEVAL-MECH step 3 (2026-08-14): candidate_urls is the POST-PREFILTER retained pool (canonical/host-level dedup, known failure forms removed, sorted by mechanical tier/weight + lexical relevance); candidate_pool mirrors it with per-candidate canonical_url/tier/mechanical_weight/weight_reason/relevance/form_reasons; prefilter_log records every removal with a stable reason (bad_url/login_wall/redirect_chain/duplicate_canonical/duplicate_host). raw_source_refs mirrors candidate_urls and candidate_pool for web_search_result entries. 0ay S1 (2026-09-20, GAP-RETRIEVAL-SYNTHETIC-JUDGEMENT-AUDITABILITY): the RAW citation-pool size travels as the optional `citation_url_count` on web_search_result entries whenever the raw pool is non-empty, so the synthetic-answer judgement (raw pool empty) and the resulting `synthetic_answer_count` / narrowed usable count are recomputable from the journal alone; a web_search_result entry carries NO URL-shaped source_url_or_ref — its source_url_or_ref is the search query string (the identity of the web_search call). The assurance/retrieval-result-v0.1.schema.json twin is migration input and stays replay-only.

unattributed_usable_count.description: 0at B face (2026-09-20, S3 friction N1): batch-level usable count NOT attributable to any declared query by literal search_query match — batch usable minus the sum of per-query usable_source_count. Identity (criterion 1): sum(per-query) + unattributed = batch usable. Emitted on multi-query activations only; single-query activations attribute the whole batch and omit the field (payload byte-identical).

synthetic_answer_count.description: 0ax S1 (2026-09-20, S3 friction N5): count of deduplicated web_search_result evidence entries with an EMPTY citation pool — URL-less synthesized answers that are NOT citable and are excluded from the usable counting (threshold 5 / cap 10). Emitted only when > 0; absence means the batch carries no synthetic answer. 0ay S1 (2026-09-20, GAP-RETRIEVAL-SYNTHETIC-JUDGEMENT-AUDITABILITY): this count is mechanically RECOMPUTABLE from the ledger alone — synthetic ⇔ source_type == web_search_result ∧ citation_url_count ABSENT (deduplicated by content_sha256, falling back to source_url_or_ref, over full_text_observed/partial_text_observed, EACH CLASS DEDUPLICATED INDEPENDENTLY). Both the Rust and the Python judge recompute it and reject a mismatch. Generation gate (replay compatibility, 0az ① 2026-09-20): the cross-check runs only for payloads the 0ay producer could have written — i.e. one carrying citation_url_count on at least one ledger entry. Declaring this field is NOT a gate: the 0ax producer declares it for any batch with a pool-less entry, so a 0ax-era payload mixing pooled and pool-less entries (no citation_url_count anywhere) may be read as synthesized throughout and must NOT be cross-checked. Payloads with no citation_url_count anywhere are deliberately unchecked — every web_search_result entry in them is pool-less by construction.

usable_source_count.description: 0ar S2 (2026-09-19, retrieval batch handoff design §5.4/§8 criterion 6): usable source count attributed to THIS query — narrowed scope since 0ax S1 (2026-09-20, S3 friction N5): text-level evidence (visibility full_text_observed/partial_text_observed), EXCLUDING URL-less synthesized answers (web_search_result with an empty raw citation pool), deduplicated by content_sha256 within its own class, mechanical — never model-reported. Per-query attribution keys on the originating web_search query; fetch-derived evidence in a merged multi-query activation is unattributed. Single-query activations carry the batch total. 0az ③ (2026-09-20, GAP-RETRIEVAL-SYNTHETIC-JUDGEMENT-AUDIT-CLOSURE): this description was still the pre-0ax WIDE wording while synthetic_answer_count in the same file already described the narrowing — the two faces are now aligned (same ruler as the countdown line, threshold 5 and cap 10). Judge face: both judges recompute the batch count from the ledger and cross-check this declared value on 0ay-generation payloads (single-query per value; multi-query via the unattributed_usable_count identity).

citation_url_count.description: 0ay S1 (2026-09-20, GAP-RETRIEVAL-SYNTHETIC-JUDGEMENT-AUDITABILITY): size of the RAW web_search citation pool this entry was formed from — the pre-prefilter count, i.e. the exact input of the synthetic-answer judgement (web_search_result ∧ raw pool empty). Emitted only when the raw pool is NON-EMPTY (> 0); absence therefore means either an empty raw pool (a synthesized, non-citable answer) or a pre-0ay journal. candidate_urls/candidate_pool carry the POST-prefilter retained pool, so citation_url_count >= len(candidate_urls) whenever both are present. 0az ② (2026-09-20, GAP-RETRIEVAL-SYNTHETIC-JUDGEMENT-AUDIT-CLOSURE): the exclusivity below is MACHINE-ENFORCED by this entry's allOf clause (citation_url_count present ⇒ source_type const web_search_result), not merely stated here.

origin_query_id.description: 0at A face (2026-09-20, S3 friction N1): dispatch lineage of THIS evidence entry — the query_id (same id domain as query_summary) of the dispatch query it serves. Attribution ladder: exact search_query match > normalized match > citation-pool backtracking (derived evidence follows the search whose candidate pool it came from) > leader lineage (first dispatch query of the activation). Emitted on multi-query activations only.
